summary.intent: Run the GSD workflow manager to discuss, plan, and execute three gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) from a CipherBox v1.1 UAT audit, using the single-terminal command center that parallelizes work across phases via background subagents.
summary.outcome: All three phases were fully discussed, planned, and executed with wave-based worktree isolation. Phase 42 closed two security vulnerabilities (cross-user unpin and quota leak). Phase 43 added crash-durable write journaling across macOS/Linux/Windows. Phase 44 implemented three-way IPNS conflict merging with CAS retry loops. All phases passed post-merge build/test gates and verifier checks, with gap-closure sub-phases generated and executed for 43 and 44.

repo: Kubo runs with the `server` profile and port 4001 exposed publicly (docker-compose.staging.yml lines 62-72) — DHT provider records for every pinned CID are broadcast publicly; CIDs are not private identifiers
The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) had only JwtAuthGuard with open signup — any account holder could destroy another user's content by supplying a harvested CID; the handler never read req.user
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning (shared-write.ts:450) — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists, making any cross-user unpin request definitively malicious
BYO IPFS integration was broken for unpin in both directions before phase 42; the new guardedUnpin semantics fix server-side for free (advisory rows count equally, 'not pinned' swallowed as 2XX)
@cipherbox/sdk and @cipherbox/sdk-core dist files go stale after source changes — must rebuild before cross-package typecheck or web tsc will report false errors against old dist

WinFsp cross-compilation consistently fails on macOS (windows-future and winfsp-sys crates) — pre-existing and unrelated to FUSE write durability changes; use cargo check for project-code validation instead

pnpm --filter @pkg test -- --testPathPattern=X is broken: pnpm inserts its own -- before forwarding, causing jest to treat the flag value as a positional regex; use pnpm --filter @pkg exec jest --testPathPattern='X' instead
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on git commits; signing failures require restarting the 1Password desktop app, not retrying the command
The gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' as a false negative even when the commit lands — always verify with git log before retrying
The worktree cleanup-wave helper resolves repoRoot from cwd — must be invoked from the repo root, never from inside an agent worktree, or it produces false base_mismatch errors
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun; write a reduced manifest containing only the remaining entries before re-running
openapi.json accumulates formatting drift as a side-effect of nest build — restore with git checkout -- before wave merges to avoid spurious conflicts
No .prettierignore existed in the repo — prettier was mangling .planning/ markdown and GSD-controlled files; .prettierignore was created and committed to fix this

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fired a global pin/rm on a CID that content-address dedup could share with another user — rerouted through guardedUnpin in phase 42
guardedUnpin added: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) → row delete → refcount → pending_unpins outbox insert (all in one transaction) → Kubo pin/rm post-commit best-effort
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning — confirmed no legitimate cross-user unpin; deferred prunedCids leak fix as future work
Caller of updateFileMetadata updated in phase 44 to consume new CAS contract return shape ({ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids}) and pass baseChildren for three-way merge

Had erroneous spawn_journal.remove call in the background upload thread (CR-08) not present in the Linux path — created orphan window between upload success and parent-pointer publish; removed in gap closure

Kubo v0.40 runs with server profile and swarm port 4001 exposed (tcp+udp) — server profile only disables local-network discovery, keeps full public DHT participation; every pinned CID's provider record is broadcast

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish did not return publishedChildren (CR-01) — the next write would compose from stale pre-merge local children, causing one-write-later lost updates; fixed in phase 44 gap closure
SyncDaemon did not accept or inject a WriteQueue — WriteParked notification pipeline was wired to the enum variant but never populated; fixed in phase 43 plan 08

workflow: Phase branches must be rebased onto the completed predecessor branch before planning begins — context files (CONTEXT.md) committed on a branch are not visible on an unrelated ancestor
Worktree cruft (node_modules, .husky/_) must be removed before running cleanup-wave or the merge aborts for all entries in the manifest
When a wave merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), use git commit --no-edit to conclude it; then manually remove the worktree and delete the branch
Full monorepo test suites must never be run in subagents or gate steps due to RAM constraints — always use targeted patterns scoped to the changed packages
Cross-package type errors after a wave merge are often dist staleness (not code bugs) — rebuild the package with pnpm build before concluding there is a real type error

For gap closure sub-phases, the verifier spawns gap plans which must go through the full plan-checker and then a new execute-phase wave; the re-verifier after gap execution decides if the phase can be marked complete
Decision coverage gate uses mechanical grep for literal 'D-NN:' citations in plan must_haves — plans that satisfy a decision semantically but don't include the citation string will fail the gate

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures required multiple app restarts mid-session; no way to automate recovery — had to prompt user each time
gsd commit helper false negatives (returns 'committed: false' while commit actually lands) caused repeated blind-retry attempts and wasted context
cleanup-wave not idempotent: already-merged worktrees cause the whole run to abort, requiring manual reduced-manifest construction for re-runs
pnpm test flag forwarding silently breaks testPathPattern — the double-dash insertion by pnpm is non-obvious and produced no error, just wrong test selection
Planner socket error mid-execution (after 3 of 8 plans) required filesystem inspection and a continuation planner spawn to recover partial work
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side-effect blocked wave merges with spurious conflicts multiple times
Wave 3 (42-05) merge left MERGE_HEAD state requiring manual git commit --no-edit and worktree cleanup
Missing .prettierignore caused prettier to mangle planning documents including a VALIDATION.md test-command table (pipe was misinterpreted as a table column separator)
Session limit interruptions (at least 3 across the session) broke execution mid-wave and required spot-checking worktree state before re-dispatching
Accidental user input ('touring wyatt web bossy') interrupted tool execution flow twice, requiring explicit continuation prompts
Decision coverage gate mechanical grep failed for D-07 because the plan satisfied the decision without the literal citation string — required editing the plan to add a redundant truth line
@cipherbox/sdk dist staleness caused 8 web typecheck errors that looked like real adoption gaps but were pure stale-build artifacts
open_items: SECURITY.md is missing for phase 42 — /gsd-secure-phase 42 was flagged as required but not run during this session
BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred — server-side unpin semantics are correct but the client never calls provider.unpin in delete flows
Writable-share prunedCids leak (shared-write.ts:450 drops pruned version CIDs without unpinning them on the server) deferred to a future phase
Rust FUSE IPNS conflict handling parity deferred (D-09) — three-way merge and CAS retry implemented in TypeScript only; Rust crate has no equivalent
Full pending-uploads UI deferred — tray notification for WriteParked implemented but the full queue management UI is a future improvement noted in deferred ideas
Phase 43 UAT file (43-UAT.md) created with 4 runtime items (FUSE crash recovery replay, mkdir conflict retry, tray notification, journal file format) requiring human verification on real hardware
Phase 44 gap closure tracking commit and final re-verification were the last actions in the session — confirm phase-complete state and source todo closure are done on next resume
Drift report job for pending_unpins (detect-only, not auto-GC) was designed and decided upon but implementation deferred to operational tooling rather than this phase
